title: Self-Regularization with Sparse Autoencoders for Controllable LLM-based Classification

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates the classifier's reliance on 'unintended features' (task-irrelevant or superficial text patterns) by extracting latent features using a fine-tuned Sparse Autoencoder (SAE). It then uses an LLM-as-a-judge with human-crafted rubrics to identify which features are irrelevant to the task, and measures the model's generalizability (Accuracy and F1 scores) when these spurious features are regularized out during training.
